column1: # parser/spec/divergent.tsv — the LIVE parser parity-debt ledger (NUR060).
# One row per divergence: src <TAB> go <TAB> ts <TAB> justification.
# Same escaping and comment rules as parse.tsv. Every row is a real,
# currently-measured divergence: the Go spec runner must reproduce the
# `go` column and the TS runner the `ts` column on every run, the row
# count is machine-pinned in both runners, and the ratchet direction is
# shrink-toward-zero — a row leaves by being FIXED and moving to
# parse.tsv, never by deletion. The rows below are one representative per
# divergence class from the 2026-08-09 probe sweep (55 divergences across
# 2,587 sources); see parser/spec/README.md §"The current debt" and
# NUR.md §NUR060, which stays open until this ledger is empty again.
# EMPTY (2026-09-26): every class the 2026-08-09 sweep found is fixed in
# both ports and its row moved to parse.tsv (NUR060, resolved). A new
# divergence lands here as a measured row until it is fixed.
